fin_a_cd.note: fin section through the motor tube (22 mm tube + 9.6 mm board, 3 mm fillet, square TE), SA, 16 m/s, on the 0.275 m fin chord, L3 grid

fin_b_cd.note: bare 9.6 mm board, square LE and TE, SA, on the fin chord, L3 grid

s5010_cd_sa.note: S5010, alpha 2.5 deg, fully turbulent SA, L3

s5010_cl_sa.note: S5010, alpha 2.5 deg, fully turbulent SA, L3

s5010_gci_pct.note: Celik GCI on cd, fine grid

cd_trip_a2p5.note: XFOIL S5010 alpha 2.5 deg, transition forced at 2 % c both sides (like-for-like with SU2 SA)

cd_free_a2p5.note: XFOIL S5010 alpha 2.5 deg, free transition Ncrit 9

e_cruise.note: AVL span efficiency, trimmed at the as-designed cruise CL, A3 predicted CG, wing + fins, finest lattice is L3; this is L2 (medium)

cdi_cruise.note: AVL trimmed induced drag at cruise CL (L2)

xnp_m.note: AVL neutral point, wing + fins, props off (L2)

elevon_cruise_deg.note: trim elevon at cruise, + TE down

lattice_spread_pct.note: spread of e over the 3 lattices

cd0_fit.note: CD_wing = A + K CL^2 fit, AVL CDi + XFOIL strip profile drag, Ncrit 9, CL 0.3-0.7, trimmed

cd0_fit_tripped.note: as cd0_fit, transition forced at 2 % c (fully turbulent bound)

clmax_trim.note: critical-section trimmed CLmax at the A3 predicted CG, XFOIL clmax at the stall Re per strip and elevon deflection
